python_conversion_notes: ColorAML (Arnaud Legoux Moving Average) must be reimplemented in Python - use the ALMA formula: ALMA = sum(weight[i] * price[i]) where weight = exp(-((i-m)^2)/(2*s^2)), m=offset*(period-1), s=period/sigma. MMRec recovery sizing logic needs careful translation: track consecutive losses and apply lot multiplier. Digit adjustment for SL/TP is standard: multiply pip values by 10 for 5-digit brokers. The custom indicator is the primary conversion challenge - all other logic (crossover detection, position management, recovery sizing) maps directly to Python with CCXT or similar.
